notes: Spanish is here: 250 lessons from zero to B1, nearly 3,000 words, three mock DELE papers and a placement test, built against the official Instituto Cervantes syllabus. Spain asks for A2 plus a civics test for nationality, so the course covers that level thoroughly on the way through and then carries you past it, because A2 on its own is a thin place to stop. It teaches the Spanish of Spain, with vosotros in the paradigm from the start and the Latin American forms shown alongside rather than left out. Every other course was corrected too: the mock exams now mirror the real papers section by section, the French grammar reference had its missing accents restored, the placement tests no longer ask about material they have not taught you yet, and hundreds of wording, answer and vocabulary errors were fixed across Croatian, French, Portuguese, German and Italian. The tutor gains practice modes and an English help toggle.
